station_name: LOOKOUT CREEK NEAR BLUE RIVER, OR

qualifiers.e: Estimated; retained, including all 235 approved estimated daily values

missing_data_policy: Absent dates omitted; no interpolation or zero filling.
date_policy: Preserve USGS daily calendar date; no UTC conversion.
run_verification: Simulation dates supplied by user. Outlet location and delineated area have not been checked; public run page requires browser verification.
usage: Paste observed_daily CSV text into Observed Timeseries; select WEPP. Fitting uses overlapping dates. Depth uses gauge area, not unverified modeled area; confirm outlet and drainage-area agreement before interpreting fit.
scope: Discharge only, not sediment observations. Record spans prefire and postfire conditions; select periods consistent with modeled land cover. Annual fitting requires checking observation completeness.
climate: Observed GRIDMET, 1986-2025, per user; target run hosted on wepp1.
